meta.name: Everyone's A Winner — Free Bet Offers Database
meta.lastVerified: 2026-10-27 (every URL checked; 2 offers re-read on the bookmaker page)
meta.disclaimer: Checked 2026-10-27 for whether each bookmaker's own page could be read — not for whether the offer is still running. No offer on this page is confirmed live except where marked. Profit estimates are labelled estimates with their assumptions shown, never a promise. Always check the bookmaker's current terms before depositing.

audit.method: All 61 offer URLs requested from this machine on 2026-10-27 with HTTP status and final URL recorded. An offer counts as verified or changed only where the bookmaker's own page showed the terms.
audit.estProfitPolicy: 59 of 61 profit figures removed outright. 2 replaced with a labelled estimate that shows its working (qualifying loss + SNR conversion at 5% commission). No figure returns unless it is derived from the offer's own stated terms.
audit.biggestFinding: Only 2 of 61 offers could be re-read against the bookmaker's own page, and BOTH had changed. The remaining 59 are unverifiable from here: 41 of 61 URLs refused or geo-blocked a non-UK IP, and most of the rest served a homepage with no readable offer panel. The page cannot claim any of these offers is live today.
audit.qualityWarning: About 30 rows share one identical shape (£10 free bet, min odds 1.50, expires 30 days) and several operators (WeBringTheFun, Cobbler, Vegas Land, RedZone, CasinoDaddy, Rabona, Black Type) are not UK-licensed or do not resolve at all. These read as placeholder rows rather than researched offers.
audit.nextSteps: Re-research from a UK IP (or with owner confirmation) before the page is published as fact; rebuild estProfit only from verified terms using the shared working.
